# BOK Financial invests in reimagined Center of the Universe


####


New BOK Plaza will help preserve an iconic Tulsa destination while creating a more welcoming gathering place downtown


3 min read


**TULSA, Okla., Nov. 19, 2026** —One of downtown Tulsa’s most recognizable landmarks is entering a new chapter, and Stacy Kymes says the project hits especially close to home.


In fact, it’s right outside the company’s front door.


BOK Financial is investing in the project to renovate the Center of the Universe and create the new BOK Plaza. The project broke ground Nov. 16 and is expected to be completed in late 2027.


“Few places are as uniquely Tulsa as Center of the Universe, and we’re proud to support its next chapter,” said Stacy Kymes, president and CEO of BOK Financial. “Like our company, this landmark is deeply rooted in the city we call home. That shared connection and role in helping define our community make this project especially meaningful to us.”


**A Tulsa landmark gets a new look**


Opened in the early 1980s, the Center of the Universe has become part curiosity, part gathering place and part downtown thoroughfare. Its famous acoustic anomaly draws visitors who stand in the center and hear their voices echoed back in an unusual way. For downtown employees, the pedestrian bridge also provides an important connection between different parts of the area.


After more than four decades of use and exposure to the elements, the plaza and bridge are ready for significant improvements. Plans include new pathways, lighting, landscaping, public art and other amenities designed to preserve the character of the landmark while making the surrounding public space more welcoming and functional.


The project is supported by BOK Financial, PSO, Williams, the City of Tulsa, the Tulsa Authority for Economic Opportunity and the George Kaiser Family Foundation.


**Right in BOK Financial’s front yard**


For BOK Financial, the connection to the site goes beyond its financial investment.


The company’s story began in Tulsa in 1910. Today, it has approximately 5,000 employees and banking operations across eight states, but Tulsa remains its headquarters and home. About 1,200 employees work downtown, with approximately 2,100 across the Tulsa area.


The Center of the Universe sits immediately outside BOK Financial’s downtown headquarters, and the company’s employee parking lot is adjacent to it. Hundreds of employees cross the pedestrian bridge as part of their commute.


And the view from the office provides a daily reminder that the landmark belongs to far more than those who work nearby. On any given day, BOK Financial employees can look outside and see visitors discovering the acoustic anomaly, students stopping by on field trips and even couples choosing the location for marriage proposals. For Kymes, those moments illustrate why investing in the landmark matters.


The project isn't simply about improving a physical space. It is an opportunity to preserve something that is distinctly Tulsa while creating a gathering place that can continue connecting people for generations. Investing in what comes next


BOK Financial already has its name connected to some of Tulsa’s most recognizable places, including BOK Tower and BOK Center. The addition of BOK Plaza creates another visible connection between the company and the city it has called home for more than a century.


But the project is ultimately about more than a name.


It’s about preserving a place Tulsans already love while preparing it for its next generation of visitors, workers and families.


As Kymes put it at the groundbreaking: “The history here matters. But so does what comes next.”


BOK Financial is proud to help make that next chapter possible.


**About BOK Financial**
For more than a century, BOK Financial has been a financial services partner for consumers, businesses and wealth clients alike. We bring the kind of financial insight and resources you’d expect from a national institution — but we deliver it with the care, clarity, and consistency of a neighbor who knows your name and understands your goals.
